author: Midnightstorm
body:
Jackson personally asked me to post his appeal for him.

Hey, it's Stimulating here to dispute my ban  
Firstly, I was told you were unable to go back in the logs far enough to prove I retired after the announcement? This being said, the 
message logs were sent at night, while I retired in the afternoon/evening. The fact that you don't have evidence to support the claim of 
me leaking is bad enough (and is banning without evidence, meaning this appeal should go through). Your only evidence is suspicion without 
conclusive evidence, which clearly isn't big enough to slander my name, especially while banning me off all Avicus platforms. In case you're 
wondering what I have to back this up, here you go. Firstly, I retired shortly after being demoted from mentor, which was the 26th of July, while
the announcement was the 7th of August. That doesn't add up. As for solid evidence? I said someone leaked me it so here it is:
http://prntscr.com/cdk2hx
http://prntscr.com/cdk2s6 
If you really need proof: 
http://prntscr.com/cdk44v it's skype lol
Clearly I wasn't leaking, and I shouldn't remain banned clearly since there is no evidence. You can even see the dates for the messages.
